description: Every function in the existing finite-arity primitive-recursive class has a presentation and a literal \(\Sigma_1\) graph that uniformly represents its evaluation in PA.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.primitive_recursive_uniform {n : ℕ}
  (f : Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PrimitiveRecursion.Args n → ℕ) (hf : Nat.Primrec' f) :
  ∃ p,
    (p.eval = fun x => f (List.Vector.ofFn x)) ∧
      Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.SigmaOne p.sigmaGraph ∧
        Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.UniformlyRepresents p.eval p.sigmaGraph
